title: '#remember ...' memory note crashes with a raw filesystem error when ~/.claude doesn't exist yet
observed: Typing '#remember to run tests' and pressing Enter (no project CLAUDE.md present) shows: '# open /tmp/kiln-qa-01kp6mpe/home/.claude/CLAUDE.md: no such file or directory' instead of a confirmation, and the note is not saved (qa/runs/c1/iterm-dark/input-bang-and-memory-120x40/02-waitfor-timeout-line18.png).
expected: The memory hint row itself promises 'applies from the next session', i.e. a successful save; internal/tui/inputmodes.go's AddMemory should create the note in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md even on a machine/HOME that has never had a ~/.claude directory before.
design_ref: internal/claude/memory/memory.go:191-207 AddMemory opens path with os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, which creates the *file* but not missing parent directories — os.OpenFile fails with ENOENT when ~/.claude/ itself does not exist, and that raw error string is what gets shown to the user.
